Translation: Excuse me, Do you know until what time it's open?

Definition: to leave one’s office or get off from work
Translation: I’ll leave work after submitting the documents.
Don’t you know when the documents will be ready?

Example: 서류를 이미 전합니다만 벌써 너무 늦어서 다음 주에 읽습니다.
Translation: I already submitted the documents, but it’s already too late, so they will be read next week.
Why are you saying it again? I’ve already heard it 100 times~!

Example: 자, 내일 부장이 와서 잘 들어요!
Translation: Okay, the manager is coming tomorrow, so please pay attention!
Excuse me, have you seen my glasses?

Example: 자, 나중에 이것에 대해서 이야기할 수 있는데 지금 배고파서 같이 먹으려고 식당에 가요.
